youMight.title: Forget to eat until you're dizzy, shaky,…

whatsGoingOn.title: Time blindness:
whatsGoingOn.body: makes it hard to notice when hours have passed without food

youMight.title: Feel "too busy" or overwhelmed to bother…

whatsGoingOn.title: Attention/executive load:
whatsGoingOn.body: causes you to block out hunger signals completely

youMight.title: Eat one small meal and realize it…

whatsGoingOn.title: Working memory gaps:
whatsGoingOn.body: mean you forget to eat or can't hold the steps of a meal plan in your head

youMight.title: Get grossed out by textures, smells, or…

whatsGoingOn.title: Executive dysfunction:
whatsGoingOn.body: **Sensory sensitivity** makes food textures or smells feel unbearable

whatsGoingOn.title: All-or-nothing thinking:
whatsGoingOn.body: means if it's not a "perfect" meal, you might skip it entirely

whatsGoingOn.title: ADHD medications:
whatsGoingOn.body: can suppress appetite during your most productive hours
